research_notes: Follow-up: obtain school annual reports/departmental appointment lists for Darwin, Laverton, Galvin Park and Moonee Ponds, including substantive hours, leave and role transitions. Verify historical legal employer/control for Laverton/Galvin Park and exact Moonee Ponds appointment/resignation; investigate earlier jobs and teaching breaks.

Reviewed 2026-09-29 APH, first speech, 2008 role recollection, own profile, contemporaneous ABC report, Victorian government school history, ABN history and Darwin school history. Targeted school annual-report and 2011/2012 searches did not produce personal appointment dates.

Secondary accounts describe an 18-month principalship; do not back-calculate an exact start date without the underlying 2013 farewell report. APH says Central, speech says Primary: official 2013 name change resolves identity without creating two jobs.

2008 role presence is not a start boundary. Job seniority and lengthy teaching descriptions do not prove continuous full-time service. Years/FTE remain unknown; no totals calculated. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; partial initial record.

2026-10-02 follow-up: added previously omitted packing/sales work from first speech. Government directory and departmental historical case study resolve public control of Laverton/Galvin Park;2011–14 strategic-plan cover supplies contemporary acting-principal evidence without tenure endpoints. Moonee Ponds farewell article found but direct open returned Failed to fetch restricted URL;18-month secondary claim remains unconverted. VRQA result naming Joanne Ryan concerns Lightning Reef Primary in Bendigo: identity unverified and not added. Next: early employers, departmental appointment/leave/hours records, Galvin transition and Moonee Ponds2012–13 annual reports. Dates/FTE/totals remain unknown; public classification is not full-time proof.

2026-10-03 follow-up recovered the original farewell report's indexed quotation: on5August2013 Ryan said she had spent18 months at Moonee Ponds. The rounded duration supports a2012 start year by explicit back-calculation (approximately early2012), but not a day/month boundary or full-time-hours inference. ABC News independently observes her as Galvin Park acting principal on22November2010, narrowing that leadership chronology without establishing appointment endpoints. Repeated Darwin, Laverton and departmental staffing searches did not establish appointment dates, hours, leave or exact payroll entities. Early packing/sales employers and teaching breaks remain unknown; no headline duration calculated.

2026-10-04 follow-up: exact-name searches for Laverton High and Galvin Park around the unresolved teaching transition found the first speech and derivative summaries only. No school annual report, departmental appointment list, payroll record, hours or leave evidence surfaced; similarly named educators were excluded. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass. Victorian and Northern Territory education personnel archives, school annual reports and service-history records remain decisive for Darwin/Laverton/Galvin Park boundaries and continuity. No substantive fact changed and no full-time duration was inferred.
